# Emma's Lab

> Handmade sculptural candles and plaster painting kits, crafted in Mettmenstetten, Switzerland. Every piece is made by hand by Ekaterina — the founder of Emma's Lab.

## About

Emma's Lab is a small Swiss handmade studio specialising in sculptural plaster candle figurines and creative plaster painting kits. The candles are hand-cast plaster figures with embedded wicks and artisan fragrance — not ordinary candles, but unique sculpted characters. Products are made in small batches with attention to detail and artistic design. Shipping within Switzerland.

- Location: Mettmenstetten, Switzerland
- Founded by: Ekaterina
- Website: https://emmas-lab.ch
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/emmas_lab_candle
- Contact: emmaslabcandle@gmail.com
- Languages: English, French, German, Russian

## Products

### Sculptural Plaster Candle Figurines (CHF 29–79)
Hand-cast plaster figurines with embedded candle wicks and artisan fragrance — each piece is a unique sculpted character that also functions as a candle. Hand-painted with detailed artwork. The scent is chosen when ordering. Available scents: Evening by the Fireplace, Northern Cranberry, Freshly Cut Grass, Nordic Berry Birch, Home Sweet Home, Library, Jungle Flora, Clean Linen.

- Frog Candle — CHF 39
- Frog in a Hat Candle — CHF 39
- Hyacinth Candle — CHF 29
- Pumpkin Candle — CHF 34 (Halloween special, was CHF 44) — a sculptural plaster pumpkin, ideal Halloween decoration and gift
- Carousel Candle — CHF 49
- Christmas Bauble Candle — CHF 29
- Mouse King Candle, Red — CHF 79
- Mouse King Candle, Blue — CHF 69

### Plaster Painting Kits (CHF 8)
Creative kits for children and adults. Each kit includes a plaster figurine, a paint set, a brush, a postcard and 2 stickers. Available designs: unicorns (Moonlight, Dreamy, Starlight), dinosaurs (Diplodocus, Stegosaurus).

### Party Boxes (CHF 49)
Sets of 10 complete plaster painting kits (unicorn or dinosaur) — CHF 4.90 per kit. Ideal for children's birthday parties, creative evenings, and group activities.

## Ordering

Orders are placed via the contact form on the website. Payment and delivery details are confirmed by email. Shipping within Switzerland (CHF 8 flat rate). International shipping available — rate confirmed per order.

## Key Facts

- All products are handmade in Switzerland
- Small-batch production — limited availability
- Candles use soy wax with artisan fragrance blends
- Plaster figures are hand-cast and painted by the maker
- Unique gifts for birthdays, home décor, and creative activities
- Privacy policy: https://emmas-lab.ch/privacy.html
- Blog: https://emmas-lab.ch/blog.html
